content_sections.heading: TNPSC Group 4 Important Dates 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should note that the detailed TNPSC Group 4 notification gives the following application and examination schedule. Once the application correction window closes, candidates will not be allowed to make further changes to the submitted online application.

content_sections.heading: TNPSC Group 4 Jobs List and Salary Details 2026
content_sections.text: The TNPSC Group 4 Notification 2026 includes 6,574 vacancies across 46 post entries in Tamil Nadu Government departments, services, corporations and boards. Major TNPSC Group 4 jobs include Village Administrative Officer (VAO), Junior Assistant, Typist, Steno-Typist, Bill Collector, Revenue Assistant, Tax Collector, Executive Officer Grade IV, Junior Inspector, Forest Watcher and Forest Guard with Driving Licence. The salary varies according to the post and organization. Most posts are placed under Pay Level 8 or Pay Level 10 , while some posts carry Level 3 or Level 5 pay. Certain corporation and board posts follow separate pay scales and EPF conditions.

content_sections.heading: TNPSC Group 4 Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Eligibility for TNPSC Group 4 varies according to the post code. Candidates must satisfy the required educational, technical and age conditions for the post they select. For a large number of posts, including Village Administrative Officer, Junior Assistant, Bill Collector, Revenue Assistant and several other Group IV posts, the minimum general educational qualification is an SSLC / 10th Standard pass or equivalent . Some posts require additional qualifications. Typist and Steno-Typist posts require the prescribed typewriting and/or shorthand qualification. Certain Junior Assistant, Executive Officer, Junior Inspector and other specialized posts require a degree, specific subject qualification, diploma, computer qualification or other technical certificate. Candidates should check the exact educational qualification against the relevant post code in the official Notification No. 11/2026 before submitting the application.

content_sections.heading: TNPSC Group 4 Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit is calculated as on 01 July 2026 . TNPSC has prescribed separate age conditions according to the post and candidate category, so candidates should not rely on one common age limit for all Group 4 posts. Important: The official notification contains detailed post-wise and category-wise age tables. Candidates belonging to BC, BCM, MBC/DC, SC, SC(A), ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen, Destitute Widow and other eligible categories should check the applicable age concession directly in Notification No. 11/2026.

content_sections.heading: TNPSC Group 4 Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: One Time Registration (OTR) is valid for five years from the date of registration. Candidates who already have a valid TNPSC OTR do not need to complete a new registration only for this examination. The ₹100 examination fee must be paid while submitting the application unless the candidate is eligible for an exemption under the TNPSC rules. Applicable fee concessions and free chances vary by category and should be checked in the official notification. Payment should be made through the online modes permitted by TNPSC. Candidates claiming fee exemption must ensure that they satisfy all applicable conditions.

content_sections.heading: TNPSC Group 4 Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: The TNPSC Group 4 online application process started on 06 October 2026 . Eligible candidates can submit the application until 05 November 2026 at 11:59 PM . Open the official TNPSC examination application portal. Complete One Time Registration if you do not already have a valid OTR. Log in using your registered credentials. Select Combined Civil Services Examination-IV / Notification No. 11/2026. Check the post options carefully before making your selection. Enter the required personal, educational and category details. Upload the required documents in the prescribed format. Pay the examination fee or claim exemption if eligible. Review all entered details carefully. Submit the application before 05 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. Save the application number and submitted application for future reference. Candidates who need to correct eligible details after submission can use the application correction window from 09 November to 11 November 2026 . Important: One Time Registration alone is not an application for TNPSC Group 4. Candidates must separately submit the online application for Notification No. 11/2026.

content_sections.heading: TNPSC Group 4 Photo and Signature Size 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the TNPSC Group 4 Notification 2026 must upload their photograph and signature in the size, dimensions and format prescribed by TNPSC. Incorrect, unclear or improperly sized images may result in problems while submitting the online application. The photograph uploaded for the TNPSC Group 4 2026 application should be a recent colour passport-size photograph taken in a photo studio against a white background . The candidate should face the camera directly, with both ears and part of the neck clearly visible. The photograph should measure 3.5 cm in width and 4.5 cm in height (130 × 170 pixels) . The image file should be between 20 KB and 50 KB , scanned at 200 DPI and saved in JPG format. The candidate's name and the date on which the photograph was taken should be printed at the bottom of the photograph. For this recruitment, the photograph should have been taken on or after 06 October 2026 , the date of the TNPSC Group 4 notification. Of the total 4.5 cm photograph height, the candidate's image should occupy approximately 3.0 cm (115 pixels) , while the name and date portion should occupy approximately 1.5 cm (55 pixels) . For the signature image, draw a box measuring 6.0 cm × 2.0 cm on a white sheet and sign inside the box using a blue or black ink pen . Scan the signature at 200 DPI and crop the image so that only the signature box is visible. The final signature should measure approximately 230 × 75 pixels and have a file size between 10 KB and 20 KB . Save it as a JPG image before uploading. Photo Size: 20 KB to 50 KB Photo Dimensions: 130 × 170 pixels Photo Physical Size: 3.5 cm × 4.5 cm Signature Size: 10 KB to 20 KB Signature Dimensions: 230 × 75 pixels Signature Physical Size: 6.0 cm × 2.0 cm Resolution: 200 DPI File Format: JPG Important: Avoid selfies, mobile-phone photographs, photocopied photographs or photographs with unsuitable backgrounds. Upload clear images in the prescribed size and format.

content_sections.heading: TNPSC Group 4 Photo Compressor – Resize Photo and Signature Online
content_sections.text: If your TNPSC Group 4 photograph or signature is larger than the prescribed upload size, you can resize and compress the image before submitting the application. Use the TNPSC Group 4 Photo Compressor and Image Resizer to adjust the photograph or signature to the required dimensions and file size. For the TNPSC Group 4 application, resize the photograph to 130 × 170 pixels and 20 KB–50 KB . The signature should be resized to 230 × 75 pixels and 10 KB–20 KB . Open the FreeJobAlert Image Resizer . Upload your TNPSC Group 4 passport-size photograph. Set the required dimensions to 130 × 170 pixels . Keep the final file size between 20 KB and 50 KB . Download the resized image and check that your face, name and photograph date are clearly visible. Upload the final JPG image while filling the TNPSC Group 4 online application. Sign with blue or black ink inside a 6.0 cm × 2.0 cm box on white paper. Scan or create a clear digital image of the signature. Open the FreeJobAlert Image Resizer . Resize the signature to 230 × 75 pixels . Keep the final file size between 10 KB and 20 KB . Save the image in JPG format and upload it to the TNPSC application portal. Tip: After compressing the photograph or signature, open the downloaded image once and make sure it is clear and not blurred before uploading it to the TNPSC portal.

content_sections.heading: TNPSC Group 4 Exam Date 2026
content_sections.text: The written examination for TNPSC Group 4 Notification No. 11/2026 will be held on 10 January 2027 from 09:30 AM to 12:30 PM . Candidates should follow the examination date given in the detailed notification released on 06 October 2026. This detailed notification is the current source for the examination schedule for this recruitment cycle.

content_sections.heading: TNPSC Group 4 Exam Pattern and Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The TNPSC Group 4 written examination will be conducted as a single OMR-based objective paper . The paper contains 200 questions for a total of 300 marks and has a duration of three hours. Exam Duration: 3 hours. Candidates must secure at least 40% or 60 marks in Part A for Parts B and C to be evaluated. Part A is the Tamil Eligibility-cum-Scoring Test. Eligible differently abled candidates covered by the notification may have the option specified by TNPSC for the language component. The detailed syllabus is provided with the TNPSC notification. Candidates should prepare according to the official syllabus applicable to Notification No. 11/2026. TNPSC Group 4 Exam Pattern and Syllabus 2026 - Check Here

content_sections.heading: TNPSC Group 4 Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection under TNPSC Group 4 Notification 2026 is primarily based on performance in the written examination followed by verification and counselling. Single-stage OMR-based written examination. Preparation of merit/ranking based on the applicable examination marks. Onscreen certificate verification for shortlisted candidates. Physical certificate verification, where applicable. Counselling and post allocation according to merit, reservation rules and candidate preference.
